greeting: Hey. Want to see what CCP can do?
pickHint: Pick pictures for the show. This loads demo media directly from Scrolller. Change it later, or use your own files.
warning: This 35-second show plays audio and flashes images and effects on your screen.
panicHint: stops everything. Esc is the default. Change it in Settings.
mediaError: These pictures could not load. Try the built-in pictures.
beat1: Let us start with flashes. Your pictures, appearing all around you.
beat2: A little pink. A little spiral. Already a different atmosphere.
beat3: Then a little brain drain. Watch everything soften for a moment.
beat4: Words can slip into the mix too. You choose what they say.
beat5: And bubbles. Go on. Pop one.
beat6: Pictures, words, motion, sound. Your own little world.
beat7: Now, let us bring it all back.
beat8: That is CCP. What happens next is yours.
title: THE EMI SHOW
